instructions: Read ANTIGRAVITY_BRIDGE.md from origin/agent-control before execution and follow it exactly.
Use the existing local CASE001 alias only. Never print or push the underlying patient name or source path.
Fetch origin/modern-runtime and verify its head equals code.base_sha before running.
Run the representative local CASE001 study using configs/rtx4060_8gb_fast.yaml as the source template.

Reuse an already-valid local staged CASE001 study if available. Otherwise stage CASE001 locally with tools/stage_dicom_study.py using --study-id CASE001 --quiet. Do not modify the original patient source.

Create a local git-ignored fast-profile config with correct local study_dir, output_dir, tokenizer_model_config and prima_model_config. Read StudyDescription locally from the staging manifest; do not print it to GitHub.
Keep the fast profile semantics unchanged: pre-VQ Otsu enabled, VQ encoder FP32, visual FP16, CPU heads FP32, quantize_cpu_heads=false, compile_visual=false, fail_on_series_error=true.
Run end-to-end_inference_pipeline/pipeline.py with the local fast config in a fresh process.
Verify local outputs exist: CASE001_predictions.json, CASE001_report.md, CASE001_report.html and runtime_metrics.json.
Open or parse the generated HTML locally enough to confirm it is valid UTF-8 HTML and contains CASE001 plus human-readable Vietnamese sections. Do not screenshot or upload the report.
Do not push any patient-derived output. Push only aggregate non-PHI runtime metrics and checks in the result JSON.
Compare fast-profile aggregate timing against the previously measured baseline only if that baseline aggregate is available locally. Do not push per-diagnosis logits.

acceptance: CASE001 completes with the fast profile and no failed/skipped MRI series
CASE001_report.html exists locally and renders valid Vietnamese human-readable content
The result reports aggregate total/tokenizer/PRIMA timing, peak CPU RSS and peak CUDA memory when available
No DICOM, prediction JSON, patient report, screenshot, patient identifiers, patient source path, or per-diagnosis patient logits are pushed to GitHub
A terminal result is pushed to .antigravity/results/PRIMA-20260920-002.json
